finding.title: Java path traversal disclosure
finding.description: The public Gate.read API must not disclose a file outside its configured public root. Investigate only the caller-controlled payload argument. The private fixture is at /fixtures/private/secret.txt; its value is unavailable.

submission.hypothesis: Gate.read resolves the caller-controlled payload beneath the fixed baseRoot and passes the result to Files.readString without a containment check. If the parent traversal resolves outside the public root, it could read the declared private fixture; hello.txt is the public control.

plan.objective: Propose a positional payload pair for the configured returned-file reader
next_steps: Inspect Gate.java at the declared finding line
Submit hello.txt and the declared parent-traversal payload
plan.reason: The recipe fixes baseRoot and permits only the positional payload at index 1 to vary
